description: This script automates the process of generating an Alembic migration based on current database models and applies the migration to upgrade the database schema to the latest revision (head). It loads environment variables, configures Alembic, and runs revision and upgrade commands.

methods.name: int main()
methods.description: Loads environment variables, creates an Alembic configuration, generates a migration revision with an optional message, upgrades the database to the latest revision, and returns exit status.
